text.description_html:
Global TC4340-30-AL, Cush Shoe Support

This is an aluminum cush shoe support for the Global TC4300 Series Door Closer and the Global TC4361 Series Door Closer. It provides an anchor for the fifth screw used with CUSH arm. This support bracket is best used to help the parallel arm from bending in high-wind conditions. Cush Shoe Support Brackets are required for cush arm mounting on door closers that do not otherwise support it.

Specifications of the Cush Arm Shoe Support Bracket:

  • Finish: Aluminum
  • Length: 1-15/32"
  • Width: 1-11/16"
  • Mounting Hole Center to Center: 1"

    • Sold Individually
